High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[I'm On The Leader (Errata)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (A New Hope, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Im On The Leader _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1u6UGsKHPIc5BSK6_lBRIKqlaF54pwcse/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Im On The Leader _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,200 bytes, SHA-256 <code>0748056966e4d39901eb30dc98341f04da47191d313a351c501ce85637c1fb75</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited strangewayes print-ready fan rendition has an original-style frame and gold E mark. It remains a qualified comparison, separate from the actual documentary source at [[I'm On The Leader (Errata)]] and the official D-E1 full face at [[I'm On The Leader (PC Errata 3)]]. The original TIFF, master, credit and license provenance remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
